name: Hushed World
summary: Turns down chatty villagers, mooing cows, humming nether portals and rain, so long play sessions sound calmer.
logoPrompt: A plump brass hand bell wrapped in a soft knitted wool scarf so it cannot ring, resting on a grassy block, faint musical notes fading into small dots, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: The same world, a little quieter.

description: **Hushed World lowers the volume of the sounds that get tiring in a long session, and leaves every other sound exactly as it was.**
- Villagers chatter and haggle at less than half their usual volume.
- Cows and mooshrooms moo more softly.
- A lit nether portal hums at about a third of its volume.
- Rain falls at half its volume; thunder stays loud.
- Same sounds, pitch and subtitles as before, only quieter.
Import the .mcpack, then turn it on under Resource Packs, either globally in the settings or for a single world.
- Made for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and newer. Hurt and death sounds keep their full volume, so you still notice danger.
- It is a resource pack only: it does not turn off achievements and needs no experimental features.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
